desc:
In forbidden times of Robloxia 1600s, hundreds of swashbuckler factions battle for their right to triumph among the seas, land, and explosive victory.

A pirate-themed melee priority combat game, heavily inspired by the likes of Team Fortress 2, Zeppelin Wars and Rogue Lineage. This game's combat is fast paced and usually involves very low time-to-kill. Pick your battles carefully, work with your team to win.

🎮Controls:
Deflect (with a melee equipped): F / X / Square
+ Dodge (after missing a deflect): Q / Y / Triangle
+ Dodge (on mobile, after missing a deflect): Double-Tap Screen
Fire: LMB / RT / R2
Reload: R / ButtonX
Aim (with a gun equipped): RMB / Q / LT / L2
Quick Chat: Num-Pad / D-Pad
